training.normalization: train-only continuous mean/std floor1; one-hot/presence stay0/1
training.class_weight: clip(sqrt(N/(5*n_selected_op)),0.5,5), normalized to mean1 on train groups
training.gradient_accumulation: complete groups only, sum weighted losses divided by entire effective batch weight denominator; not mean of microbatch means
training.selection: lowest fixed weighted validation CE among gate-passing complete epochs; earliest tie
training.save: initial and every complete epoch; no resampling or extra fits
training.timeout: Eight complete epochs required for fit completion. Time/update/size cap or error ends the run and prevents game entry; retain partial evidence, no automatic restart.

model.decision: masked group softmax over all real joint candidates; mask padding only

offline_entry_gate.interpretation: development engineering entry only, not economic promotion

development_games.seeds: original two validation seeds, already consumed development data
development_games.order: first seed trained two seats, then remaining first-seed four arms/seats; safety failure stops dispatch. Compare trained two-seat mean terminal cash against corresponding teacher-task plus epoch6 two seats before second seed.
development_games.repeats: only after12 complete, trained first seed both seats via official file entry, excluded from statistics

task_candidate_scope: frozen teacher economic opportunities, not all official legal actions
data_role: Original8train/2validation only; development, not independent testing
numerical_upper_bound: Optimistic deterministic complete ordered numeric input consistency bound, not MLP attainable accuracy
composition: Four original validation round2-seat observation trajectories; TaskAgent teacher task+epoch6 versus CropAgent epoch6 actions/crop/reservations; not original teacher raw action or new closed-loop equivalence
training_seed_scope: single fixed model/batch generator; no search or restart
acceptance: Eight epochs complete; frozen offline gates, whole validation independent NumPy export identity, actual action or reservation influence and privacy isolation before any games. No epoch passes means zero games.
game_acceptance: All attempted games720states/719actions/DONE both, no errors/fallback; ordered official replay, actor+rival actions, task/crop traces and cash reproduced; maximum12development+2entry repeats.
stop: No extension, retries, relaxed gates, replacement games, additional data, PPO or DAgger. Failure consumes budget; old evidence retained.
limitations: original teacher-task labels come from original crop choices; epoch6 deployment causes distribution changes not solved by wiring parity
teacher-task plus epoch6 is a hybrid reference, not the original frozen teacher
padding mask is not official legality; teacher economic candidate generator remains
two development seeds and one opponent do not establish competitive generalization
strict cross-device ID agreement can fail; never loosen after results
